mechanism_narrative: Sustained recovery in WORKPLACES mobility (rising from -22.1% to -12.0% over four weeks) signals normalization of commuting patterns. Commuters generate incidental retail visits during work-week transit, driving RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the mean of the prior 28 days, or WORKPLACES reverses by more than 5 percentage points in week t+1.
